title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Seamless.AI ships a sales-intelligence MCP server — 'prompt to closed-won,' with prospecting, enrichment, outreach, and pipeline all agent-callable
bullets.summary: Seamless.AI's new MCP server exposes its real-time B2B contact/enrichment engine to Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, n8n, Gumloop, and ActivePieces, so a single prompt can find prospects, enrich records, launch personalized campaigns, and book meetings without tool-switching.
bullets.how: Leads today: top-of-funnel sourcing/enrichment is now agent-callable — the raw material a Construct sales-and-pipeline operator agent needs for Brand 9 Signs / PRAGMA. Wire Seamless as the sourcing feed, not a standalone reseller line.

bullets.title: Clari + Salesloft open the revenue layer to external AI — MCP expansion puts forecasting, deal inspection, and Copilot call intelligence into every major AI ecosystem, natively in Claude's connector directory
bullets.summary: The July 9 expansion connects execution data, conversation intelligence, and forecasting signals across the full revenue lifecycle, building on the April 2026 MCP launch and rolling to ChatGPT/Microsoft Copilot/Gemini through late summer.
bullets.how: Completes the go-to-market picture: Seamless for sourcing, Clari/Salesloft for forecast and deal-health. One operator agent reading both is the affordable 'build' SMBs buy from us instead of an enterprise RevOps stack.

bullets.title: Anthropic distribution consolidation holds — Opus 5 default day-one on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, the 2026-07-28 MCP spec (stateless core + MCP Apps + Tasks) landed, Cognizant partnership (Jul 27)
bullets.summary: The platform story is standardization and reach, not a new model tier; the finalized spec makes MCP Apps and Tasks the stable substrate to build the fleet on.
bullets.how: Build The Construct's operator agents against the finalized spec now; the distribution surface (three clouds + SI channel) is where our internal servers get leverage.

bullets.title: Frontier field stays seated — no drop cleared the 24h bar; Opus 5 (Jul 24) still newest above GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Grok 4.5, Muse Spark 1.1
bullets.summary: Model tier is quiet while MCP dominates; Gemini 3.6 Flash remains the cheap high-volume workhorse (~17% fewer tokens on comparable jobs) against Opus 5 for reasoning-heavy work.
bullets.how: Watch, don't switch; nothing changes the fleet's model routing this cycle.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'Multi-Agent Design — Optimizing Agents with Better Prompts and Topologies' (2502.02533, MASS framework)
bullets.summary: Shows MAS performance is dominated by per-agent prompt quality and interaction topology, and proposes a staged search (block-level prompts → topology → global) rather than naively stacking agents.
bullets.how: The build-order rubric for The Construct: harden each operator agent's prompt and scope in isolation before composing it into the swarm; more agents without topology discipline regresses performance.

praxis_lesson: The vertical MCP wave rotated in one week from ad-intelligence (Guideline) to sales-intelligence and revenue-ops — the whole go-to-market data stack is going agent-callable (Seamless for sourcing/enrichment, Clari + Salesloft for forecast and deal-health, both natively in Claude's directory). The operator wedge is the same shape each time: don't resell any single feed; stand up one Construct sales-and-pipeline operator agent that reads the freshest MCPs, run each through the least-authority scope pass, and — per 2502.02533 — harden that single agent in isolation before composing it into the swarm. Own the orchestration and context discipline, not any one data source.
